✨ تفاصيل العقار
{/* Hero Image */}

{property.location?.neighborhood}

عن العقار

{property.description}

{property.videoUrl && (

)}
📏
{property.area} م²

))}

{similarProperties.map(sim => (
onViewDetails && onViewDetails(sim)} style={{transition: 'transform 0.2s'}} onMouseEnter={e => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(-5px)'} onMouseLeave={e => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'}>
{sim.price?.toLocaleString()} ج

))}
